description.value: Fusion Curry & Donair is a fast-food stall inside the Lansdowne Centre food court in Richmond, serving a broad fusion menu of Indian curries, kebabs, donairs, and shawarmas made fresh to order. The menu spans butter chicken, lamb shank, falafel platters, and several vegetarian options including Shahi Paneer, Chana Masala, and Dal Makhni. Online ordering with in-store pickup is available, and the business is also listed on Skip The Dishes, Uber Eats, and DoorDash.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at fusiondonair.ca confirms the business is a real, operating fast-food stall in the Lansdowne Centre food court in Richmond, BC, with a full menu, active online ordering, and delivery partnerships. Address (1030–5300 No. 3 Road, Richmond, BC V6X 2C7) and phone (+1 604-447-2655) are confirmed via the website's contact and footer pages; neither appears in OSM tags. The menu page confirms multiple vegetarian dishes; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
OSM tags indoor=room and level=0 confirm this is an indoor food court stall — bike parking is outside the mall building and not addressed anywhere in the listing.
